decisions.title: Ship the new sign-in screen this week?
Split the weekly report into per-region runs?
decisions.about: The weekly report job currently runs on a single machine and takes about forty minutes. Splitting it into per-region runs would cut the wait for most readers, but it adds three more scheduled jobs to watch.
